# LearnWebCraft

> > Comprehensive web development education platform covering React 19, Next.js 15, Vue.js 3, TypeScript, and modern frontend architecture with 75+ free tutorials.

LearnWebCraft provides production-ready guides for modern frontend engineering, from semantic HTML5 and CSS fundamentals to advanced topics like React Compiler, Server Components, micro-frontends, and browser AI integration. The platform emphasizes practical, enterprise-grade patterns for building scalable web applications.

## Key Topics

- React 19 & React Compiler
- Next.js App Router & Server Components
- Vue.js 3 & Composition API
- TypeScript
- Semantic HTML5
- Frontend Architecture & Design Systems
- Performance Optimization
- SSR & Hydration
- Vue Router & Pinia
- Web Platform APIs
- Micro-frontends & Module Federation
- Speculation Rules API
- WebLLM & Browser AI
- CSS Grid & Flexbox
- Production Deployment Strategies

- [About LearnWebCraft | Empowering Developers | LearnWebCraft](https://learnwebcraft.com/about): Mission & values: free web dev education for HTML, React, Next.js & more

## React & React 19

- [React 19 Migration: Vite & Compiler Strategy | LearnWebCraft](https://learnwebcraft.com/learn/react/migrate-vite-react-react-19-compiler): Migrate Vite apps to React 19 Compiler with automatic memoization & optimization
- [Enterprise React Architecture: Scalable Folder Structures](https://learnwebcraft.com/learn/react/structuring-large-react-apps): Structure large React apps with DDD & feature-based architecture patterns
